title: Index reference search with concrete roots and include filters
failure_signature: An index-refresh reference search passed a Windows wildcard as a literal rg path and returned invalid-path error 123.
trigger_preconditions: A read-only search spans a skill entrypoint and its reference directory on Windows.
The intended selection includes all files under a known references directory.
candidate_workaround: Read the concrete skill file directly, enumerate the concrete references directory, and use -g filters when recursive filename selection is needed.
recurrence_guard: Reject every rg command containing a wildcard in a path argument; use concrete roots, directory enumeration, or explicit -g include filters.
rollback: Discard the failed search result, retain error 123 as an operational negative, and rerun once against concrete paths.
scope_boundary: Read-only local skill-reference discovery only; no repository-suite, source-authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
